question: Can any of the ten lowest-impact members be removed from rank49 while retaining the full joint circuit contract?
construction: Each arm removes exactly one preregistered site from the frozen passing rank49 support. Arm order is the frozen ascending local-impairment order.
selection_rule: Select the first arm satisfying all existing coordinate, behavior, and full-vocabulary control thresholds under both cross-fits.

predictions.pred_a_authority_self_clamp_finiteness_a: authorities replay, self-clamp is exact, values are finite, and <=77 forwards execute
predictions.pred_b_at_least_one_rank48_arm_is_jointl: one or more single-deletion arms passes every joint gate
predictions.pred_c_at_least_two_rank48_arms_are_join: two or more distinct single-deletion arms pass
predictions.pred_d_selected_deletion_is_outside_dono: the selected removed site is not in the frozen donor-patch top20
predictions.pred_e_selected_arm_is_crossfit_stable: selected minimum-coordinate projections differ by <=0.05 and per-task behavior projections differ by <=0.05 across fits

decision: Promote the first passing rank48 support and repeat backward deletion from that frozen support; if none pass, rank49 is one-deletion-minimal over the ten best local candidates.
